Dear Dr. Huang,

Thank you for agreeing to speak at our annual conference. We have scheduled your keynote for 9:00 am on June 4 in the main hall. The session will last 45 minutes, followed by a 15 minute Q&A.

We will cover your hotel and travel expenses. Please send your reciepts to events@cascadeforum.org after the event.

Warm regards,
Lena Fischer

labels.notes: "15 minute Q&A" could arguably take a hyphen ("15-minute"); left unlabeled as minor.
